<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"></head><body>
<title>Judicial Review Desk</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --ground: #f4f2ec;
    --surface: #ffffff;
    --surface-2: #faf8f3;
    --surface-3: #efece3;
    --border: #e4dfd2;
    --border-strong: #cfc8b6;
    --ink: #1c1e26;
    --ink-2: #4b4e5b;
    --ink-3: #82859360;
    --muted: #7c8090;
    --navy: #1a2340;
    --navy-2: #232d50;
    --brass: #9c6c26;
    --brass-2: #855b1e;
    --brass-soft: rgba(156,108,38,0.12);
    --fatal: #b3261e;
    --fatal-soft: rgba(179,38,30,0.10);
    --warn: #a5680d;
    --warn-soft: rgba(165,104,13,0.13);
    --ok: #2c6a4a;
    --ok-soft: rgba(44,106,74,0.12);
    --info: #2f5aa8;
    --info-soft: rgba(47,90,168,0.11);
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,40,.05), 0 4px 16px rgba(20,24,40,.05);
    --shadow-lg: 0 8px 40px rgba(20,24,40,.14);
    --serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif;
    --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    --mono: "SFMono-Regular", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", "Consolas", "Liberation Mono", monospace;
    --r: 10px;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
      --ground: #0f121b;
      --surface: #161a26;
      --surface-2: #1c2030;
      --surface-3: #232839;
      --border: #2a3042;
      --border-strong: #3a4258;
      --ink: #e9eaef;
      --ink-2: #b2b6c4;
      --muted: #838799;
      --navy: #151c33;
      --navy-2: #1e284a;
      --brass: #c99a4e;
      --brass-2: #d9ab5f;
      --brass-soft: rgba(201,154,78,0.15);
      --fatal: #e2726a;
      --fatal-soft: rgba(226,114,106,0.14);
      --warn: #d9a03f;
      --warn-soft: rgba(217,160,63,0.14);
      --ok: #57b487;
      --ok-soft: rgba(87,180,135,0.14);
      --info: #6f9ae6;
      --info-soft: rgba(111,154,230,0.14);
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --ground: #0f121b;
    --surface: #161a26;
    --surface-2: #1c2030;
    --surface-3: #232839;
    --border: #2a3042;
    --border-strong: #3a4258;
    --ink: #e9eaef;
    --ink-2: #b2b6c4;
    --muted: #838799;
    --navy: #151c33;
    --navy-2: #1e284a;
    --brass: #c99a4e;
    --brass-2: #d9ab5f;
    --brass-soft: rgba(201,154,78,0.15);
    --fatal: #e2726a;
    --fatal-soft: rgba(226,114,106,0.14);
    --warn: #d9a03f;
    --warn-soft: rgba(217,160,63,0.14);
    --ok: #57b487;
    --ok-soft: rgba(87,180,135,0.14);
    --info: #6f9ae6;
    --info-soft: rgba(111,154,230,0.14);
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    --shadow-lg: 0 10px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--ground);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  a { color: inherit; }
  button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  .mono { font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  ::selection { background: var(--brass-soft); }
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

  /* ---------- app shell ---------- */
  .app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 236px 1fr; min-height: 100vh; }

  .rail {
    background: var(--navy);
    color: #e8ddc6;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  }
  .brand { padding: 20px 20px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
  .brand .seal {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; flex: none;
    background: linear-gradient(150deg, #b9873a, #8a5e1f);
    display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 18px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  }
  .brand .bt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 16px; color: #fff; line-height: 1.15; }
  .brand .bs { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b6a583; margin-top: 1px; }

  .nav { padding: 14px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .nav .lbl { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a7d61; padding: 10px 12px 6px; }
  .nav button {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%;
    padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d7ccb5;
    border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; text-align: left; transition: background .12s, color .12s;
  }
  .nav button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); color: #fff; }
  .nav button.active { background: var(--brass); color: #1a1204; font-weight: 600; }
  .nav button.active .ico { opacity: 1; }
  .nav .ico { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: none; opacity: .8; }
  .nav .count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #e8ddc6; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .nav button.active .count { background: rgba(0,0,0,.16); color: #1a1204; }

  .rail-foot { margin-top: auto; padding: 14px 16px 18px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); font-size: 11.5px; color: #9a8d70; }
  .rail-foot b { color: #cbbd9c; font-weight: 600; }

  /* ---------- topbar ---------- */
  .main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
  .topbar {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    padding: 12px 26px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground) 82%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .crumb { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
  .crumb b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .crumb .sep { opacity: .5; }
  .spacer { margin-left: auto; }

  .role-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .role-switch button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); padding: 5px 13px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; }
  .role-switch button.on { background: var(--navy); color: #f0e6d0; }
  .icon-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2); display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .icon-btn:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
  .who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
  .avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(140deg,var(--navy-2),var(--navy)); color: #e8ddc6; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
  .who .wn { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.15; }
  .who .wr { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }

  .content { padding: 24px 26px 60px; max-width: 1180px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
  .view { display: none; animation: fade .25s ease; }
  .view.show { display: block; }
  @keyframes fade { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .view, .app * { animation: none !important; } }

  .page-h { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .page-h h1 { font-size: 26px; }
  .page-h p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; margin: 3px 0 0; }
  .page-h .spacer { margin-left: auto; }

  /* ---------- primitives ---------- */
  .btn { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 9px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform .08s, border-color .12s; }
  .btn:hover { border-color: var(--brass); }
  .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
  .btn.primary { background: var(--navy); color: #f2e8d3; border-color: var(--navy); }
  .btn.primary:hover { background: var(--navy-2); }
  .btn.brass { background: var(--brass); color: #1a1204; border-color: var(--brass); font-weight: 600; }
  .btn.brass:hover { background: var(--brass-2); }
  .btn.sm { padding: 5px 11px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px; }
  .btn.ghost { background: transparent; box-shadow: none; border-color: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .btn.ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-3); border-color: transparent; }

  .card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .pad { padding: 18px 20px; }

  .chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; }
  .chip .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
  .chip.fatal { color: var(--fatal); background: var(--fatal-soft); }
  .chip.warn { color: var(--warn); background: var(--warn-soft); }
  .chip.ok { color: var(--ok); background: var(--ok-soft); }
  .chip.info { color: var(--info); background: var(--info-soft); }
  .chip.neutral { color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--surface-3); }
  .chip.brass { color: var(--brass-2); background: var(--brass-soft); }

  .stage-chip { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); }

  /* countdown pill */
  .pill { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 62px; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 9px; line-height: 1.05; border: 1px solid transparent; }
  .pill .n { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .pill .u { font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .85; margin-top: 1px; }
  .pill.fatal { background: var(--fatal-soft); color: var(--fatal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fatal) 30%, transparent); }
  .pill.warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 26%, transparent); }
  .pill.ok { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
  .pill.done { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--muted); }

  /* tables */
  .tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
  .tbl th { text-align: left; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .tbl td { padding: 13px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 13px; vertical-align: middle; }
  .tbl tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
  .tbl tbody tr { transition: background .1s; cursor: pointer; }
  .tbl tbody tr:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
  .tbl .soc { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; }
  .tbl .sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; }
  .cellflex { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

  .filters { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
  .seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; padding: 3px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; }
  .seg button.on { background: var(--brass-soft); color: var(--brass-2); }

  /* metric tiles */
  .tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px,1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  .tile { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .tile .tn { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .tile .tl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-top: 2px; }
  .tile.accent .tn { color: var(--brass-2); }

  /* matter workspace */
  .matter-head { display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .matter-head .mh-main { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
  .matter-head h1 { font-size: 25px; }
  .matter-head .mmeta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; align-items: center; }
  .matter-head .mmeta b { color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 600; }

  .tabbar { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 20px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .tabbar button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); padding: 10px 15px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; white-space: nowrap; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  .tabbar button:hover { color: var(--ink); }
  .tabbar button.on { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--brass); font-weight: 600; }
  .tabbar .tc { font-size: 11px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--muted); padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .tab-panel { display: none; }
  .tab-panel.on { display: block; animation: fade .2s ease; }

  .grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; gap: 16px; align-items: start; }
  @media (max-width: 900px){ .grid2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .app { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .rail { position: static; height: auto; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; } .nav { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; } .nav .lbl, .rail-foot { display: none; } }

  .dl-row { padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .dl-row + .dl-row { margin-top: 9px; }
  .dl-row .dl-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .dl-row .dl-t { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; }
  .dl-row .dl-s { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 2px; }
  .fatal-rail { border-left: 3px solid var(--fatal); }
  .warn-rail { border-left: 3px solid var(--warn); }
  .ok-rail { border-left: 3px solid var(--ok); }

  .kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr; gap: 9px 14px; font-size: 13px; }
  .kv dt { color: var(--muted); }
  .kv dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); }
  .kv dd b { font-weight: 600; }

  /* artifact lifecycle */
  .art { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); padding: 15px 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .art + .art { margin-top: 10px; }
  .art-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .art-head .an { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
  .art-head .av { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--surface-3); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 5px; }
  .stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; overflow-x: auto; }
  .step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; flex: none; }
  .step .sd { width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .step.done .sd { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); }
  .step.done .sd::after { content: "✓"; color: #fff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; }
  .step.cur .sd { border-color: var(--brass); background: var(--brass); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--brass-soft); }
  .step .sl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
  .step.done .sl, .step.cur .sl { color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 600; }
  .step .bar { width: 26px; height: 2px; background: var(--border); margin: 0 3px; }
  .step.done .bar { background: var(--ok); }

  .timeline { position: relative; padding-left: 22px; }
  .timeline::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; background: var(--border); }
  .tl-item { position: relative; padding: 0 0 16px; }
  .tl-item::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -22px; top: 4px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brass); border: 2px solid var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong); }
  .tl-item .tl-d { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
  .tl-item .tl-b { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 1px; }
  .tl-item .tl-b b { font-weight: 600; }

  .callout { border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px 15px; font-size: 12.5px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .callout.warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 25%, transparent); }
  .callout.info { background: var(--info-soft); color: var(--info); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--info) 22%, transparent); }
  .callout b { font-weight: 700; }
  .callout .ci { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }

  .section-t { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .09em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 11px; font-family: var(--sans); }

  /* reports */
  .rep-controls { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
  .field label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
  .field select, .field input { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; }
  textarea.note { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; resize: vertical; min-height: 62px; }

  .enrich-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--surface-2); }
  .enrich-card + .enrich-card { margin-top: 9px; }
  .enrich-card .ec-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .wave { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 26px; }
  .wave span { width: 3px; background: var(--brass); border-radius: 2px; opacity: .7; }
  .thumbs { display: flex; gap: 9px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .thumb { width: 84px; height: 62px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-3), var(--surface-2)); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .thumb .cap { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); color: #fff; font-size: 9px; padding: 2px 4px; }

  .empty { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); padding: 40px 20px; font-size: 13px; }

  /* pdf preview */
  .pdf { background: #fff; color: #16181d; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 34px 38px; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .pdf .ph { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 2px solid #1a2340; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .pdf .ph .fn { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 15px; color: #1a2340; font-weight: 700; }
  .pdf .ph .fs { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9c6c26; }
  .pdf h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 3px; color: #16181d; }
  .pdf .pdim { color: #666; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .pdf .pdl { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; border-top: 1px solid #eee; padding-top: 10px; }
  .pdf .pdl b { color: #1a2340; }

  .toast { position: fixed; bottom: 22px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px); background: var(--navy); color: #f0e6d0; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
  .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

  /* assignment modal */
  .modal-bg { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(10,12,20,.5); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 200; padding: 20px; }
  .modal-bg.show { display: flex; animation: fade .15s ease; }

    </button>`;
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById('assignModal').classList.add('show');
}
function doAssign(k){
  const m = MATTERS.find(x=>x.id===assignTarget); if(!m) return;
  m.associate = k;
  if(m.stage==='Awaiting assignment') m.stage = 'Merits review';
  closeAssign();
  toast(`${m.soc} assigned to ${PEOPLE[k].name} — associate notified`);
  const shown = document.querySelector('.view.show').id.replace('view-','');
  if(shown==='matter'){ openMatter(m.id); } else { setView(shown); }
  renderMatters();
}
function closeAssign(){ document.getElementById('assignModal').classList.remove('show'); }
function applyRoleChrome(){
  document.querySelector('.brand .bs').textContent = canViewAll() ? 'JR Head console' : 'Associate workspace';
}

// ================= view routing =================
function setView(name, keepCrumb){
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.remove('show'));
  document.getElementById('view-'+name).classList.add('show');
  document.querySelectorAll('#nav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.view===name || (name==='matter'&&b.dataset.view==='matters')));
  if(!keepCrumb){
    const label = {matters:'Matters',deadlines:'Deadline board',reports:'Work reports'}[name] || 'Matters';
    document.getElementById('crumb').innerHTML = `<b>${label}</b>`;
  }
  if(name==='matters') renderMatters();
  if(name==='deadlines') renderDeadlines();
  if(name==='reports') refreshSubjectPicker();
}
document.querySelectorAll('#nav button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setView(b.dataset.view));

// filters
document.querySelectorAll('#filt-stage button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('#filt-stage button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));b.classList.add('on');renderMatters();});
document.querySelectorAll('#filt-type button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('#filt-type button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));b.classList.add('on');renderMatters();});

// role switch
document.querySelectorAll('#roleSwitch button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
  ROLE = b.dataset.role;
  document.querySelectorAll('#roleSwitch button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on', x.dataset.role===ROLE));
  const u = PEOPLE[currentUser()];
  document.getElementById('whoName').textContent = u.name;
  document.getElementById('whoRole').textContent = u.role;
  document.getElementById('whoAv').textContent = u.init.slice(0,1);
  document.getElementById('matters-sub').textContent = canViewAll() ? 'Every judicial-review file across all associates — assign, reassign and track.' : 'The files assigned to you, their stage and their fatal clock.';
  applyRoleChrome();
  // re-render current
  const shown = document.querySelector('.view.show').id.replace('view-','');
  if(shown==='matter'){ setView('matters'); } else { setView(shown); }
  refreshSubjectPicker();
  toast(ROLE==='head'?'Viewing as JR Head — all associates':'Viewing as Nauman — your own matters only');
});

// theme
document.getElementById('themeBtn').onclick=()=>{
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const cur = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
  const isDark = cur==='dark' || (!cur && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
  root.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark?'light':'dark');
};

// toast
let toastTimer;
function toast(msg){ const t=document.getElementById('toast'); t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2600); }

// keyframe for wave pulse
const st=document.createElement('style'); st.textContent='@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:1}}'; document.head.appendChild(st);

// init
applyRoleChrome();
renderMatters();
refreshSubjectPicker();
</script>
